body:
N-34 SLICE 1, review blocker fixed (helper-n34s1, 16 Nov 2026 night; PR #111; still BUILT, NOT WALKED, the item stays todo).
BLOCKER: the CHANGELOG line said a live upload or a cover is never taken for the studio song and a song on a compilation is left alone. Both false as written (the reviewer's run, reproduced by tests). FIXED AT THE SOURCE OF THE FALSE SENTENCE: the line now says what the matcher does. Refused: an entry whose own title is marked live, a remix, an acoustic or another version when the song's is not (Remastered, Clean, Radio Edit, Explicit are ignored), a cover by another artist, an album credited to somebody else (tribute, Various Artists), a release type that is not album/ep/single, a name the fold cannot hold. Cannot be told by name: (1) a live UPLOAD with the studio title and length is the studio song; (2) a same-artist best-of typed album becomes the song's album unless the original is an album or EP among the hits, so it ALSO beats an original that came out only as a single.
PINNED so nobody states the opposite again (tests/test_album_finder.py): test_only_the_catalogues_label_refuses_a_live_hit_so_an_unlabelled_live_upload_is_the_studio_song (the recorded Wembley hit with its label removed is same_recording), test_a_best_of_by_the_same_artist_typed_album_is_chosen_when_it_is_the_only_release_hit (derived from the recorded best-of: matched, 2011-11-08, album) and test_an_original_single_loses_to_a_same_artist_best_of_typed_album_whatever_the_dates (The Wall's recorded answer typed single, 1979, loses to the best-of, 2011). They guard behaviour that was already there, so each was mutated in a throwaway copy and SEEN FAILING for the right reason: a 'best of' title refusal turns the second red; a refusal by the hit's album title ('live') turns the first red; dropping the type from the ordering turns the third red.
I DID NOT ADD A REFUSAL (the review offered it): a title heuristic would not make 'a compilation is left alone' true either (a best-of called 'Gold' passes), and what a same-artist best-of becomes is a design choice that slice 2 would store as a permanent stamp. FOR THE LEAD, BEFORE SLICE 2 STORES A STAMP: step 0 recorded no compilation or live record_type, so nothing proves the type refuses a same-artist best-of. The exposure is larger than the review said: because album/ep rank before single whatever the dates, ANY song first released as a non-album single and later put on a same-artist best-of typed album gets the best-of. Choose: (a) accept; (b) a title heuristic as a second layer with a removal trigger; (c) ask the artist's discography for the first release of the song. My view: (c) is the proper source, (b) only on top of it.
NOT TOUCHED (the review marked them information): the two Arabic rows hold only through the unsupported guard (whichever of #110 and #111 merges second must rewrite them to assert no match by key inequality); album() second gather now passes wait_s=left at the gate for a person route (the PR says defaults unchanged); album_dryrun fixture_name slug collisions; _id_order with a non-ASCII digit; the record_type counts in the album_finder docstring (49/1/13) do not match the fixtures (LANDMVRKS: 6 album, 13 single, 1 ep); the dry-run timing test.
